description: Land Title Settlement Department - Panama Pattu, Pothuvil D/S Division, Ampara District - Settlement No. 4593 - Ampara
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement orders under the Land Settlement Ordinance, specifically final orders for land parcels in Ampara District. It contains detailed schedules of land lots being settled to "The State" with precise measurements (A-R-P), lot numbers, and legal references. The content is primarily concerned with land registration and ownership matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
